air_quality_daily.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT "City" AS city, trim(split_part("Station Name", ',', 1)) AS station, "Station Name" AS station_full_name, CAST(TRY_CAST("Timestamp" AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS day, avg(TRY_CAST("PM2.5 (ug/m3)" AS DOUBLE)) AS pm25_avg, count(TRY_CAST("PM2.5 (ug/m3)" AS DOUBLE)) AS pm25_n, avg(TRY_CAST("PM10 (ug/m3)" AS DOUBLE)) AS pm10_avg, count(TRY_CAST("PM10 (ug/m3)" AS DOUBLE)) AS pm10_n, avg(TRY_CAST("NO2 (ug/m3)" AS DOUBLE)) AS no2_avg, count(TRY_CAST("NO2 (ug/m3)" AS DOUBLE)) AS no2_n, avg(TRY_CAST("Ozone (ug/m3)" AS DOUBLE)) AS ozone_avg, count(TRY_CAST("Ozone (ug/m3)" AS DOUBLE)) AS ozone_n, avg(TRY_CAST("CO (mg/m3)" AS DOUBLE)) AS co_avg, count(TRY_CAST("CO (mg/m3)" AS DOUBLE)) AS co_n FROM (SELECT * FROM raw UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT * FROM pune UNION ALL BY NAME SELECT * FROM bengaluru) WHERE "City" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ALL) SELECT city, station, station_full_name, day, CASE WHEN pm25_n >= 64 AND (pm10_n = 0 OR pm25_avg <= pm10_avg) THEN round(pm25_avg, 2) END AS pm25, CASE WHEN pm10_n >= 64 THEN round(pm10_avg, 2) END AS pm10, CASE WHEN no2_n >= 64 THEN round(no2_avg, 2) END AS no2, CASE WHEN ozone_n >= 64 THEN round(ozone_avg, 2) END AS ozone, CASE WHEN co_n >= 64 AND co_avg > 0 THEN round(co_avg, 2) END AS co FROM d WHERE day IS NOT NULL

bbmp_grievances.sql: SELECT "Complaint ID" AS complaint_id, trim("Category") AS category, trim("Sub Category") AS sub_category, CAST(TRY_CAST("Grievance Date" AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS grievance_date, trim("Ward Name") AS ward_name, trim("Grievance Status") AS status FROM raw

tn_assembly_2026.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT TRY_CAST("AC No" AS INTEGER) AS ac_no, trim("AC Name") AS ac_name, trim("Candidate") AS candidate, trim("Party") AS party, TRY_CAST("EVM Votes" AS BIGINT) AS evm_votes, TRY_CAST("Postal Votes" AS BIGINT) AS postal_votes, TRY_CAST("Total Votes" AS BIGINT) AS total_votes, TRY_CAST("Vote Share" AS DOUBLE) AS vote_share_pct FROM raw) SELECT *, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY ac_no ORDER BY total_votes DESC) AS position FROM t

ward_winners_2026.sql: SELECT 'Pune (PMC)' AS city, TRY_CAST("Ward No." AS INTEGER) AS ward_no, last_value(nullif(trim("Ward Name"),'') IGNORE NULLS) OVER (ORDER BY TRY_CAST(_id AS INTEGER)) AS ward_name, trim("Seat") AS seat, trim("Reservation") AS reservation, trim("Elected Candidate Name") AS winner, CASE trim("Party") WHEN 'BJP' THEN 'Bharatiya Janata Party' WHEN 'NCP' THEN 'Nationalist Congress Party' WHEN 'INC' THEN 'Indian National Congress' WHEN 'NCP-SP' THEN 'Nationalist Congress Party Sharadchandra Pawar' WHEN 'SHS' THEN 'Shiv Sena' WHEN 'SHS (UBT)' THEN 'Shiv Sena (Uddhav Balasaheb Thackeray)' ELSE trim("Party") END AS party, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS winner_votes FROM raw UNION ALL SELECT 'Mumbai (BMC)', TRY_CAST("Ward No." AS INTEGER), NULL, NULL, NULL, trim("Elected Candidate Name"), trim("Party"), TRY_CAST(replace("Valid Votes Received", ',', '') AS BIGINT) FROM mumbai

mapping.resource: GBA Wards Mapping to Divisions and Sub-divisions Tables

gba_wards_2025.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT last_value(nullif(trim("Corporation"),'') IGNORE NULLS) OVER w AS corporation, last_value(nullif(trim("Zone"),'') IGNORE NULLS) OVER w AS zone, last_value(nullif(trim("Division"),'') IGNORE NULLS) OVER w AS division, TRY_CAST("Ward no" AS INTEGER) AS ward_no FROM mapping WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY TRY_CAST(_id AS INTEGER))), p AS (SELECT trim("Corporation_Name") AS corporation, trim("Assembly_Name") AS assembly_constituency, TRY_CAST(split_part("Ward_No_Name", '-', 1) AS INTEGER) AS ward_no, trim(regexp_replace("Ward_No_Name", '^[0-9]+\s*-\s*', '')) AS ward_name, TRY_CAST("TOT_P" AS INTEGER) AS population, TRY_CAST("TOT_M" AS INTEGER) AS male, TRY_CAST("TOT_F" AS INTEGER) AS female, TRY_CAST("SC_P" AS INTEGER) AS sc_population, TRY_CAST("ST_P" AS INTEGER) AS st_population FROM raw WHERE TRY_CAST("Sl_No" AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.*, m.zone, m.division FROM p LEFT JOIN m ON lower(m.corporation) = lower(p.corporation) AND m.ward_no = p.ward_no

chennai_metro_ridership.sql: SELECT CAST(strptime("Month", '%b-%y') AS DATE) AS month, TRY_CAST(replace("Total Passenger Flow", ',', '') AS BIGINT) AS total_riders, TRY_CAST(replace("Closed Loop (Ridership)", ',', '') AS BIGINT) AS closed_loop_card_riders, TRY_CAST(replace("QR Tickets (Ridership)", ',', '') AS BIGINT) AS qr_ticket_riders, TRY_CAST(replace("NCMC (Ridership)", ',', '') AS BIGINT) AS ncmc_card_riders FROM raw WHERE TRY_CAST(replace("Total Passenger Flow", ',', '') AS BIGINT) IS NOT NULL

chennai_reservoirs.sql: SELECT 'Poondi' AS reservoir, TRY_CAST("Year" AS INTEGER) AS year, (list_position(['jan','feb','mar','apr','may','jun','jul','aug','sep','oct','nov','dec'], lower(left(m,3)))) AS month, TRY_CAST(replace(CAST(v AS VARCHAR),',','') AS DOUBLE) AS storage_mcft FROM (UNPIVOT (SELECT * EXCLUDE (_id) FROM raw) ON COLUMNS(* EXCLUDE ("Year")) INTO NAME m VALUE v) UNION ALL SELECT 'Cholavaram' AS reservoir, TRY_CAST("Year" AS INTEGER) AS year, (list_position(['jan','feb','mar','apr','may','jun','jul','aug','sep','oct','nov','dec'], lower(left(m,3)))) AS month, TRY_CAST(replace(CAST(v AS VARCHAR),',','') AS DOUBLE) AS storage_mcft FROM (UNPIVOT (SELECT * EXCLUDE (_id) FROM cholavaram) ON COLUMNS(* EXCLUDE ("Year")) INTO NAME m VALUE v) UNION ALL SELECT 'Chembarambakkam' AS reservoir, TRY_CAST("Year" AS INTEGER) AS year, (list_position(['jan','feb','mar','apr','may','jun','jul','aug','sep','oct','nov','dec'], lower(left(m,3)))) AS month, TRY_CAST(replace(CAST(v AS VARCHAR),',','') AS DOUBLE) AS storage_mcft FROM (UNPIVOT (SELECT * EXCLUDE (_id) FROM chembarambakkam) ON COLUMNS(* EXCLUDE ("Year")) INTO NAME m VALUE v) UNION ALL SELECT 'Veeranam' AS reservoir, TRY_CAST("Year" AS INTEGER) AS year, (list_position(['jan','feb','mar','apr','may','jun','jul','aug','sep','oct','nov','dec'], lower(left(m,3)))) AS month, TRY_CAST(replace(CAST(v AS VARCHAR),',','') AS DOUBLE) AS storage_mcft FROM (UNPIVOT (SELECT * EXCLUDE (_id) FROM veeranam) ON COLUMNS(* EXCLUDE ("Year")) INTO NAME m VALUE v) UNION ALL SELECT 'Red Hills (Puzhal)' AS reservoir, TRY_CAST("Year" AS INTEGER) AS year, (list_position(['jan','feb','mar','apr','may','jun','jul','aug','sep','oct','nov','dec'], lower(left(m,3)))) AS month, TRY_CAST(replace(CAST(v AS VARCHAR),',','') AS DOUBLE) AS storage_mcft FROM (UNPIVOT (SELECT * EXCLUDE (_id) FROM redhills) ON COLUMNS(* EXCLUDE ("Year")) INTO NAME m VALUE v)

rainfall_monthly.sql: SELECT 'Bengaluru' AS city, TRY_CAST("Year" AS INTEGER) AS year, list_position(['jan','feb','mar','apr','may','jun','jul','aug','sep','oct','nov','dec'], lower(left(m,3))) AS month, TRY_CAST(v AS DOUBLE) AS rainfall_mm FROM (UNPIVOT (SELECT "Year", COLUMNS('^(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)') FROM raw) ON COLUMNS(* EXCLUDE ("Year")) INTO NAME m VALUE v) UNION ALL SELECT 'Chennai' AS city, TRY_CAST("Year" AS INTEGER) AS year, list_position(['jan','feb','mar','apr','may','jun','jul','aug','sep','oct','nov','dec'], lower(left(m,3))) AS month, TRY_CAST(v AS DOUBLE) AS rainfall_mm FROM (UNPIVOT (SELECT "Year", COLUMNS('^(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)') FROM chennai) ON COLUMNS(* EXCLUDE ("Year")) INTO NAME m VALUE v)

bengaluru_domestic_flights.sql: SELECT make_date(TRY_CAST("Year" AS INTEGER), TRY_CAST("Month" AS INTEGER), 1) AS month, trim("Origin") AS origin, CASE upper(trim("Dest")) WHEN 'BIDAR AIRPORT, KARNATAKA' THEN 'BIDAR' WHEN 'CUDDAPAH' THEN 'KADAPA' WHEN 'DEHRA DUN' THEN 'DEHRADUN' WHEN 'GOA' THEN 'GOA' WHEN 'DABOLIM' THEN 'GOA' WHEN 'MOPA, GOA' THEN 'GOA' WHEN 'KALABURAGI, KARNATAKA' THEN 'KALABURAGI' WHEN 'COCHIN' THEN 'KOCHI' WHEN 'PONDICHERRY' THEN 'PUDUCHERRY' WHEN 'ALLAHABAD' THEN 'PRAYAGRAJ' WHEN 'RAJKOT INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT' THEN 'RAJKOT' WHEN 'AYODHYA INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT' THEN 'AYODHYA' WHEN 'SHIVAMOGGA AIRPORT' THEN 'SHIVAMOGGA' WHEN 'HINDON AIRPORT' THEN 'HINDON (GHAZIABAD)' ELSE upper(trim("Dest")) END AS destination, trim("Dest") AS destination_as_published, TRY_CAST("Pax From Origin" AS DOUBLE) AS passengers_out, TRY_CAST("Pax To Origin" AS DOUBLE) AS passengers_in, TRY_CAST("Freight From Origin" AS DOUBLE) AS freight_out_tonnes, TRY_CAST("Frieght To Origin" AS DOUBLE) AS freight_in_tonnes FROM raw

karnataka_crime_districts_2025.resource: District and Commissionerate-wise Crimes (IPC/BNS and SLL) in Karnataka in 2025
karnataka_crime_districts_2025.sql: SELECT trim("Districts/Units") AS unit, CASE WHEN trim("Districts/Units") = 'Karnataka Railways' THEN 'Railways' ELSE last_value(CASE WHEN "Sl No" IS NULL AND "IPC/BNS Crimes" IS NULL THEN trim("Districts/Units") END IGNORE NULLS) OVER (ORDER BY TRY_CAST(_id AS INTEGER)) END AS police_range, TRY_CAST("IPC/BNS Crimes" AS INTEGER) AS ipc_bns_crimes, TRY_CAST("SLL Crimes" AS INTEGER) AS sll_crimes FROM raw QUALIFY "IPC/BNS Crimes" IS NOT NULL AND upper(trim("Districts/Units")) <> 'STATE'

bengaluru_traffic_offences.resource: BTP - Cases booked under M.V Act (2018-25)
bengaluru_traffic_offences.sql: SELECT trim("Type of Offences") AS offence, TRY_CAST(y AS INTEGER) AS year, TRY_CAST(v AS BIGINT) AS cases FROM (UNPIVOT (SELECT "Type of Offences", COLUMNS('^20[0-9][0-9]$') FROM raw) ON COLUMNS('^20') INTO NAME y VALUE v) WHERE lower(trim("Type of Offences")) <> 'total' AND v IS NOT NULL
